row.name: flutter-food-delivery-app
row.description: In this repo I have build an awesome Flutter food delivery app ui. This Flutter UI challenge is taken from the dribbble. The main beauty about this UI is their hero animation while moving towards the food detail page. This Flutter Food delivery app UI tutorial is beneficial for those who want to learn the advanced concept for building the flutter ui. Apart from these I have used the latest version of flutter i.e Flutter 2.0 to building this app.
